Interface LogProperty.PropertyGetter.ChildPropertyGetter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - value type this getter converts to.
All Superinterfaces:
LogProperty.PropertyGetter<T>
Enclosing interface:
LogProperty.PropertyGetter<T>
public static sealed interface LogProperty.PropertyGetter.ChildPropertyGetter<T> extends LogProperty.PropertyGetter<T>
A LogProperty.PropertyGetter that delegates to a parent() getter and transforms its result, rather than reading directly from LogProperties itself. Getters returned by LogProperty.PropertyGetter.map(PropertyFunction), LogProperty.PropertyGetter.mapResult(PropertyFunction), LogProperty.PropertyGetter.orElse(Object), and LogProperty.PropertyGetter.orElseGet(Supplier) are all child getters chained onto some ancestor LogProperty.PropertyGetter.RootPropertyGetter.
